text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "He worked as a consultant in the environmental and communication fields, partly on a freelance basis.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Later, he earned a degree as an agricultural engineer from the Technical Centre for Tropical Agriculture (TTL), and an environmental science degree from Swiss Federal Institute of Technology ETH Zurich."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Danach machte er das Diplom als Agrotechniker am Technikum für tropische Landwirtschaft und später das Diplom als Umweltnaturwissenschaftler an der ETH Zürich.", "severity": 0.2, "before": ""}, {"side": "en", "quote": "Beat Jans was president of the Basel-Stadt section of the Social Democratic Party (SP) from 2000 to 2005, and a member of the cantonal parliament from 2001 to 2011.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Beat Jans is married and has two daughters."}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "Beat Jans war von 2000 bis 2005 Präsident der SP Basel-Stadt.\nVon 2001 bis 2011 gehörte er dem Grossen Rat von Basel-Stadt an.", "severity": 0.2, "before": "Beat Jans ist verheiratet und hat zwei Töchter."}]}
